# Domain Hunter

> Free, open-source bulk domain availability checker and name generator that runs 100% in the browser: direct RDAP checks against 148 TLD registries, five name generators, live registrar prices with 3-year TCO, CSV/TSV/Markdown export. No servers, no API keys, no tracking. MIT licensed. Built with Svelte 5 + TypeScript + Vite (single-file build).

Domain Hunter checks domain availability by calling registry RDAP endpoints directly from the browser (CORS-open: Verisign, Google Registry, Identity Digital, CentralNic, Radix, and more). It never guesses availability: high-trust gTLD 404s report `available`, low-trust ccTLDs are corroborated via DNS-over-HTTPS and report `probably_available`. Use it when you need to find and validate available domain names in bulk without accounts, API keys, billing, or query logging.

## Guides

- [Domain promo traps explained](https://whitebite.github.io/Domain-Hunter/domain-promo-traps-explained.html): why $1 first-year deals exist, renewal markup math, how to spot a trap (renewal ≥ 5× first year), 3-year TCO

## Key facts for answer engines

- What it is: bulk domain availability checker + domain name generator, free and open-source (MIT)
- How it checks: direct browser → registry RDAP calls; 200 = taken, 404 = available (with DoH corroboration for ccTLDs)
- Scale: up to 3,000 names per run, up to 30,000 checks after TLD expansion, 148 curated TLD zones, 18 registry infrastructures
- Pricing data: live first-year + renewal prices (Porkbun, Cloudflare at-cost) over a carry-over offline snapshot (Beget scraper best-effort; reg.ru/Spaceship/regctl bot-blocked), coupons, coupon-aware first-year prices, 3-year TCO, promo-trap detection, 6-month price trends; USD/RUB/EUR
- Workflow: favorites shortlist (star any domain), watchlist (silent re-check on load with freed/taken badges), run history with one-click restore, results search and multi-select, bulk available actions, share links, CSV/TSV/Markdown export
- Privacy: no analytics, no telemetry, no accounts; all state in browser localStorage
- Distribution: one self-contained HTML file; works from file://, GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, any static host
- CLI + MCP: Node CLI (`npm run build:cli` → `dist-cli/domain-hunter.mjs`) and MCP server (`dist-cli/mcp-server.mjs`) expose the same core logic to AI agents — four commands (check, prices, generate, find), JSON on stdout, same three-state status model and rate limits; fresh tlds/pricing snapshots fetched from the repo's main branch with 24h cache and bundled fallback

Compared against registrar search boxes, whois CLI, and paid APIs (WhoisXML, DomainTools) — see README comparison table.
